transition.evidence: Paper changes stay silent so geographic movement is not confused with a factual event.

swap.evidence: Map focus and city labels stay silent.

click.evidence: No interface click is implied by a city dot.

count.evidence: A route does not assert a distance, time or count.

reveal.evidence: A quiet paper landing can mark a supplied image card arriving, once per card.

type.evidence: Arabic names appear as joined whole labels without typing sounds.
